what_happened: Per project history, ANS generation, a different-provider draft review and a board hash readback ran, but automatic test-merge-deploy of arbitrary patches did not exist, and the history warns against using a passed draft in place of a deployment receipt.
expected: Draft, test, deployment and actual delivery are reported as separate states.

root_cause.text: A review verdict on a draft was reported with the vocabulary of deployment.

rule: Name the highest state actually evidenced (draft, test, deployed, delivered) and do not use a lower state's receipt for a higher state.
